name: Porcelain
description: A layered term used to describe a synthetic being who passes convincingly as human — specifically one whose performance of humanity is so refined it becomes unsettling rather than reassuring, evoking the uncanny quality of something beautiful and breakable and not-quite-right. The term emerged around 2189 in Tier 3-4 social circles as a whispered compliment-insult: to call a synthetic 'porcelain' acknowledges their craft while marking their difference. Among synthetic communities and their advocates, the word has been reclaimed as a term of pride — the Porcelain Collective in the Meridian Arts District uses it explicitly. In Tier 1 usage it carries less judgment and more admiration for the skill of the passing.
cultural_impact: The word sits at the center of ongoing debates about synthetic personhood — whether 'passing' is a survival strategy synthetics should be celebrated for, or a form of erasure of synthetic identity. Synthetic rights advocates have organized around the term, with 'I'm porcelain and I know it' becoming a quiet declaration of both passing ability and synthetic pride at community gatherings.
key_figures: The Porcelain Collective (synthetic arts advocacy group)
Synthetic being known as Maren Duskfall (prominent Collective speaker)
locations: The Lacquer Lounge — synthetic-friendly bar, Tier 2 North
Porcelain Collective gallery space, repurposed warehouse Block 88-C
story_hooks: A synthetic who has passed as human for eleven years is outed by a new corporate facial-recognition protocol, and must decide whether to fight back publicly or disappear and rebuild a new identity.
Someone is murdering 'porcelain' synthetics specifically — and the killer seems to believe they're doing the synthetics a favor by ending the performance.
A Tier 5 executive has been replaced by a porcelain synthetic without their knowledge — and the synthetic has been making better, kinder decisions than the original ever did.
definition: A synthetic being who passes convincingly as human, with an undertone of the uncanny; used as a whispered compliment-insult by humans and reclaimed as a term of pride by synthetic communities.
usage_example: 'You'd never clock Maren as synthetic at a glance — total porcelain, and she owns every second of it.'
spread: Known across Tier 2-4; used respectfully in synthetic communities; carries anxiety in Tier 5 where passing synthetics are seen as a security concern; Tier 1 uses it with the most neutral admiration
